note_on_numbers: Paper: 12,879 / 115,246 epithelial (11.2%), split into 4 cancer and 4 normal epithelial subclusters. This object: 78,977 cells, 9 tumour samples; candidates (non-immune, non-stromal) 15,391 (19.5%); malignant 560 (0.7%). Candidate split: scATOMIC normal + CNV negative 10,554; scATOMIC normal + CNV positive 3,808; scATOMIC tumour + CNV negative 469; scATOMIC tumour + CNV positive 560. Low malignant = consensus requires both methods (scATOMIC calls most candidates normal; early lesions have low CNV burden); no author labels in this object, so no label-mapping check possible. 0.7% is this analysis object's value, not the paper's

evidence: Original paper Methods (doi:10.1038/s41467-021-21043-4): tumour digestion, FACS of PI-negative live cells; PBMC separately by HISTOPAQUE; TCR enrichment is library-level. Paper reports no separate fibroblast/endothelial class; not evidence that stroma is absent in tissue
note_on_numbers: Paper: 176,447 cells (tumour 82,622; PBMC 93,825); malignant epithelial 2,787 -> 3.37% of tumour cells, 1.58% of tumour+PBMC. This object: tumour samples only (10 units, no PBMC), 80,516 cells; candidates 4,294 (5.3%): malignant 1,979 (2.5%), uncertain 1,197 (scATOMIC normal + CNV positive), non-malignant 1,118. Malignant + uncertain = 3,176 (3.9%) vs paper 2,787. 2.5% is this object's consensus value; difference from 3.37% comes from re-QC, decontX filter and the two-method consensus

decision: exclude from TME v1 / CoVarNet v1 (kept in integration v2, not deleted)
evidence: GEO protocol: fresh biopsies digested (gentleMACS), RBC lysis, loaded on 10x 5'+VDJ with no sorting. Public files are only the authors' T-cell subset (GSE179994_all.Tcell.rawCounts.rds, per-sample Tcell.Seurat.object); non-T cells were not deposited. Earlier stated reason 'T-cell-sorted design' was an unverified assumption and is wrong
note_on_numbers: Object is 100% immune (122,793 cells, 46 tumour units, no blood). Cell-type composition is an artefact of author post-hoc subsetting, so it cannot enter sample-level co-variation. It is excluded as a computational T-cell subset, not as an experimentally enriched dataset
